gloss: number of flat objects (sheets, tickets, etc.)

definitions.explanation: The count or quantity of flat, thin objects such as sheets of paper, tickets, photographs, plates, or cards. Derived from the counter {枚|まい} (for flat things) plus {数|すう} (number).

examples.japanese: ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枚数|まいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the number of copies.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枚数|まいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枚数|まいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて、⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧きらない。
examples.english: There are too many photos to fit in the album.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of the counter ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ (for flat objects) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Used when discussing quantities of flat items without specifying the exact count. Similar in construction to ⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧ (number of long objects) and ⟦{個数|こすう}→個数：19290_kosuu⟧ (number of pieces).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枚数|まいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: limit on the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not enough (sheets/tickets/etc.)
